title: SKE Crystal Banana Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: SKE Crystal Banana Ice Nic Salt pairs the mellow sweetness of ripe Banana with a clean Menthol exhale. The Banana flavour is soft and creamy with a subtle richness, offering a smooth, comforting inhale. A cool Menthol note follows, providing a crisp contrast that lifts the profile without overwhelming the fruit. It's a simple and satisfying flavour pairing, ideal for fans of smooth fruit profiles with a touch of ice. The balance between the sweet Banana and cooling finish makes this an appealing choice for those who enjoy a chilled vape with a mellow edge. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this nicotine salt e-liquid is formulated for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it delivers a smooth throat hit and faster nicotine absorption for a more satisfying vape. SKE is renowned for delivering bold, satisfying flavours with sleek, user-friendly design. Their Crystal Bar disposables helped set a new standard for flavour clarity and convenience, and the SKE Crystal Nic Salt range continues that legacy ”offering the same popular flavours in a format compatible with a wide range of refillable pod kits and MTL vape devices. With a presence in over 50 countries, SKE remains at the forefront of vaping innovation.
